content.text: Use this uploaded photo as the wealthy-clan tortured-romance female lead. Make a modern-urban stand-in-bride wealthy-clan animated short drama — she was brought in to replace his dead first love. The day her three-year contract expires she hands him divorce papers, and the man who never once truly looked at her in those three years suddenly begins hunting for her like a madman across the whole city. Add Chinese subtitles for short-video platform distribution and a sad piano BGM.
